author: Noki Doki
content:
stumbled upon the linker maps from the E3 2002 demo on TCRF, each version had a mario.MAP and a bigger marioL.MAP. I thought the bigger one was the full game and the smaller one was just the demo, but actually the map from the final release matches the smaller one pretty closely, while the bigger one has larger functions in all libs and adds an L at the end of each lib name (e.g. JSystemL.a instead of JSystem.a) https://tcrf.net/Proto:Super_Mario_Sunshine#Linker_Address_Map
